title: Serenaders and guitarist Battle House
summary: Serenading and fish fries; Battle House, a fingerstyle guitarist and house-party king, his nickname and favourite tune.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands

blocks.x: Well did you hear many guys walking around serenading? Oh yeah, yeah.

A lot of guys. I used to serenade myself. After I used to play mandolin, you know. Yeah. Yeah. Well, there's a fella around here that call him Battle House. He's around here. He's one of the lead serenaders. Yeah. I met him the day before yesterday. Now uptown. He sure was glad to see me. He picked the guitar, you know. Picked all them old breakdowns and things.
